title: Psychons act on dendrons in conscious experience, and dendrons on psychons in perception and memory

statements.text: In the full hypothesis the interaction runs both ways: psychons act on dendrons across the whole world of conscious experience, and dendrons act on psychons in all perceptions and memories. The unitary picture may explain the global character of a visual experience from moment to moment.
